title: Xanthe and the Inheritance
author: Ines Fairweather
blurb: Quentin Villalobos, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
